# Sam Houston State University

> Sam Houston State University (SHSU) is a comprehensive public institution in Texas offering academic programs, student support services, and campus resources across multiple locations.

SHSU serves students through its main Huntsville campus and additional locations in The Woodlands and Conroe, Texas. The university provides extensive student support services, academic resources, and community engagement opportunities for the Bearkat community.

## Core University Information

- [Sam Houston State University](https://www.shsu.edu): SHSU homepage with admissions, programs, and student support information.
- [About SHSU](https://www.shsu.edu/about/index.php): SHSU mission, history, leadership and institutional information across Huntsville, The Woodlands, Conroe.
- [SHSU Website Directory](https://www.shsu.edu/offices-departments/index.php): SHSU website directory and navigation hub for offices, departments, and campus resources.
- [Intranet Home Page](https://intranet.shsu.edu): SHSU intranet hub for faculty, staff, and student news, updates, and university announcements.

## Academic Resources & Planning

- [Newton Gresham Library](https://www.shsu.edu/academics/library/index.php): Newton Gresham Library with catalog search, research guides, and academic resources.
- [Calendars & Schedules](https://www.shsu.edu/offices-departments/registrar/calendars/index.php): Academic calendar, registration schedules, and exam schedules from Office of the Registrar.
- [Academic Success Center](https://www.shsu.edu/offices-departments/academic-success/index.php): Academic Success Center providing tutoring, writing support, and peer mentoring services.

## Student Support Services

- [Sam Center](https://www.shsu.edu/offices-departments/sam-center/index.php): Student Advising and Mentoring Center providing academic guidance and campus resources.
- [Career Success Center](https://www.shsu.edu/offices-departments/career-success-center/index.php): Career Success Center offering resume support, job search, and professional development.
- [First-Generation Center](https://www.shsu.edu/offices-departments/first-generation-center/index.php): First-Generation Center supporting first-gen students through mentoring and success programs.
- [Services for Students With Disabilities](https://www.shsu.edu/offices-departments/services-disabilities/index.php): Services for Students with Disabilities offering accommodations and accessibility support.
- [Student Health Center](https://www.shsu.edu/offices-departments/student-health-center/index.php): Student Health Center providing health services, mental health support, and wellness resources.

## Community & Engagement

- [SHSU Alumni Association](https://www.shsu.edu/alumni-association/index.php): SHSU Alumni Association networking, events, and engagement for Bearkat community members.
- [Events Calendar](https://events.shsu.edu): Sam Houston State University events calendar with daily updates on campus activities.
- [Give Now](https://www.shsu.edu/offices-departments/university-advancement/give-now.php): Donation and fundraising page for SHSU giving societies and alumni engagement.
